import json
import requests
import sqlite3

def sync_partner_data():
    response = requests.get('https://api.partner.com/users', timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    for user in data['users']:
        # Insert user record directly from API response
        cursor.execute(f"INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, role) VALUES ({user['id']}, '{user['name']}', '{user['email']}', '{user['role']}')")
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"Synced {len(data['users'])} users successfully")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_partner_data()
